== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Dark Reconnaissance (Errata)]] (<code>1240_20</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 21), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-21-Dark_Reconnaissance.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-darkreconnaissance-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Dark Reconnaissance]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on opponent's location. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. 'Stolen' on Swilla Corey is treated as 'placed in owner's Used Pile' and it may target a weapon instead of a device.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_20</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, slip number 21 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. The Episode I icon under the expansion sphere is drawn as on the card image. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB4-21-Dark_Reconnaissance-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B07 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
